3019.title: ACP plan capability and mode updates do not reach the plan lifecycle
3019.rootCauseOneLine: ACP registration omits the plan action, turn handling drops promptMode, and mode updates are classified as noise.
3019.proposedFix: Add a provider-agnostic session-mode capability and lifecycle contract, then map ACP modes, promptMode, session/set_mode, and current_mode_update through it.
3019.caveats: The current bb contract uses composerActions instead of a supportsPlan field. The tests prove the shared ACP path without a live OMP account.
